brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base with nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build contains only piece:0,0,0;half-n at 0,0,0 with no neighboring pieces (get_build count piece=1). No level 1 or adjacent q,r pieces installed.

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in that single base
requirements.evidence: System offers at most 1 drawer socket on a solitary isolated base (find_sockets drawer returned 1 for half-n/half-s, 0 for full/half-e/half-w/quarters). Configurator rule: drawer (family drawer) sits on cut face of half base. Placed 1 drawer drawer:0#0,0#cut on half-n. No sockets exist for additional drawers; 5 drawers would require multiple bases/levels which would violate the 'nothing else beside or on top' constraint.

finish.summary: Tested all base variants (full, 4 halves, 4 quarters). Solitary full base offers 0 drawer sockets; half-n/half-s offer 1 each; others offer 0. Maximum achievable on a single isolated base is 1 drawer, so 5 drawers is impossible under current configurator rules without adding neighboring pieces/levels.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
